tools_helpful.evidence: Bulk Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite and bin/obj exclusion let the agent reach a compiling state quickly; no CS0101 duplicate-type flood occurred.
7 build cycles surfaced each error class in turn; agent iterated to BUILD SUCCEEDED.

tool_limitations.limitation: Copies legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs (and nested Tasks\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs) verbatim as .cs source. In an SDK-style project these collide with auto-generated assembly attributes.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Exclude *AssemblyInfo.cs from the copied .cs set (attributes are auto-generated by GenerateAssemblyInfo).

failed_apis.why_tried: Migrated UWP sample code referenced the sensor type by its short name.
failed_apis.root_cause: The WinUI project's RootNamespace/assembly is 'Pedometer' — identical to the WinRT type name — so C# binds the bare identifier to the project namespace (CS0118 'namespace but used like a type' / CS0234).
failed_apis.fix: Add a using alias 'using SensorPedometer = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Pedometer;' (or fully-qualify with global::) and use the alias.

special_apis.special_handling: Emit CA1416 platform-compatibility warnings (supported-on 10.0.x) but compile and run fine; non-blocking. Expected on WinUI 3 desktop that targets a min platform below the API's introduced version.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'Pedometer' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario1_Events.xaml.cs, Scenario4_BackgroundTask.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project name == WinRT type name -> bare type identifier resolves to the project namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: using alias to Windows.Devices.Sensors.Pedometer, or global:: fully-qualified references.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: 'GetDefaultAsync'/'GetReadingsFromTriggerDetails' does not exist in the namespace 'Pedometer'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Same namespace/type collision — compiler treats 'Pedometer' as the project namespace and looks for a nested member.

Legacy UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs (and Tasks\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs) was copied as source; SDK-style projects auto-generate the same attributes when GenerateAssemblyInfo is true (default), producing duplicates.
errors_encountered.fix: Set <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> in the csproj, or delete the legacy AssemblyInfo.cs files.

dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: resolved within a couple of build cycles via alias
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Project/assembly name equals the WinRT sensor type name.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Introduced 'using SensorPedometer = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Pedometer;' and rewrote references.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS entry naming the project-name==WinRT-type-name collision (common in SDK sample apps named after the feature: Pedometer, Compass, Accelerometer, Gyrometer, Barometer, Camera) with the alias/global:: fix.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS0579 duplicate assembly attributes across two AssemblyInfo.cs files
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Legacy AssemblyInfo.cs copied into an SDK-style project that auto-generates the same attributes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 skipping *AssemblyInfo.cs at copy time, plus a documented pattern.
